onboarding.title: Welcome to VideoDubber
onboarding.s1-body: VideoDubber turns a video's spoken audio into another language — transcribe, translate, synthesize a new voice, and remux — all on this machine, fully offline once set up.
onboarding.s1-before: Before your first project we'll quickly:
onboarding.s1-li1: Check this machine has everything it needs to run.
onboarding.s1-li2: Let you pick your source & target languages and a transcription model.
onboarding.s1-li3: Download the AI models for those languages. This needs an internet connection and can take several minutes depending on the model size.
onboarding.s1-hint: The app, media tools and workers are already bundled — only the language models are fetched on first run.
onboarding.s2-warn: Some checks need attention — you can still continue, but downloads or dubbing may fail until they're resolved.
onboarding.s2-unavailable: Couldn't run the checks yet. Make sure the local services have started, then re-check.
onboarding.s3-same-lang: Source and target language must be different.
onboarding.s3-no-pair: No prebuilt translation package is listed for {{ from }} → {{ to }}. The app will try to fetch one, but it may not be available offline.
onboarding.s3-no-catalog: Model catalog unavailable. The default model will be used once services are reachable.
onboarding.s3-voice-download: Download a Piper voice for {{ lang }}
onboarding.s3-voice-hint: A natural offline voice. You can pick a different voice (or add more) later from Settings.
onboarding.s3-no-voice: No bundled Piper voice is listed for {{ lang }} yet. You can add one later from Settings; dubbing will fall back to an available voice.
onboarding.s4-done: ✓ All set — your language models are installed.
onboarding.s4-fetching: Fetching the AI models for {{ from }} → {{ to }} — this one-time download needs an internet connection. Keep this window open.
onboarding.s4-retry-hint: Check your internet connection, then retry — it picks up the remaining models.
onboarding.s4-ready: You're ready to create your first project.

editor.title: Editor
editor.subtitle: Review and refine the translation. Long lines and timing conflicts are flagged below.
editor.preview-unavailable: In-app preview is unavailable here (the browser cannot load local files directly). Use “Open output folder” to play the video.
editor.settings-intro: Review every option applied to this dub. Change an engine, model or voice below, then re-dub from the affected stage — the earlier stages are reused (e.g. a new voice re-renders without redoing transcription or translation).
editor.refine-hint: Review & refine re-reads the whole transcript with a context-capable AI and polishes pronouns/terminology (re-dub from “Review & refine” to apply). Model size (e.g. TranslateGemma 4B → 12B) is managed in Settings → Engines.
editor.redub-title: Re-run the pipeline from “{{ step }}”, reusing the earlier stages
editor.redub-recommended: Your changes take effect from {{ step }} — click that stage to re-dub.
editor.redub-none: No changes yet. You can still re-dub from any stage (e.g. after installing a different model in Settings → Engines).
editor.ctx-intro: Used by context-aware translation (cloud LLMs, Gemma 3 chat, Argos + Gemma repair) to keep pronouns, terms of address, and terminology consistent. Fix something once — e.g. “student → teacher: gọi ‘thầy’, xưng ‘em’” — then Save & re-translate to apply it everywhere.
editor.synopsis-ph: What is this video about, and who is talking to whom?
editor.pronouns-ph: Per speaker pair, the address terms to use (e.g. học sinh → giáo viên: gọi 'thầy', xưng 'em').
editor.save-retranslate-title: Save, then re-run the pipeline from the translation step so the sheet is applied
editor.no-sheet: No translation character sheet yet — one is generated automatically on the first context-aware translation run (cloud LLM, Gemma 3 chat, or Argos + Gemma repair), or create one now to steer pronouns and terminology.
editor.review-hint: No voice has been synthesized yet. Adjust the translations below (and the cast & pronoun sheet), save, then continue — dubbing resumes at speech synthesis.
editor.warnings: ⚠ Some segments have warnings — untranslated lines, over-long subtitles, or timing conflicts.
editor.no-segments: No segments yet. Run the pipeline through the transcription and translation steps first.
editor.untranslated-title: The translation is identical to the source — the translator likely skipped this line. Edit it or re-run translation.
editor.seg-voice-title: Voice used when you regenerate this segment
editor.tighten-title: Re-translate this line shorter so it fits its timing window, then re-synthesize
